Title: Sellwood Seed Swap Cabinet
Description: A repurposed medicine cabinet on the library's side lawn, full of labeled envelopes of vegetable and flower seeds. Leave what you have extra of, take what you'll plant.

Title: Alberta Street Mosaic Pillar
Description: Tiled mosaic column on the sidewalk outside the coffee shop, covered in broken plates and mirror shards. Different artist adds a panel each summer.
